scope: Read-only review of frozen parent pipeline integration before final artifact audit

checks.detail: Initializer strong U is required for exact C++ GetStagedNativeLayoutFacts. Selected binding and composed runtime each require one strong T, zero U. NativeLayoutBinding replacement role and exact three initializer helper headers are source-bound.

Whole-selected gate, comparator, consumer UND, ODR, finalizer, hash-tied accessor checks precede package gate. Only D1-only failure accepted for run1; run2 requires all GO with run1 twin. Each run archives manifest and receipt state.
Both fresh composed object byte hashes must match independently of final PRX D1 equality.
Combined unresolved names must exactly equal frozen contract plus retained admitted extensions before packaging; unexpected/missing/weak imports refuse.
Final ELF dynamic imports are NID-decoded and equal contract names; unknown/malformed NIDs refuse; SDK/contract backing checked.
Measured combined UND delta must exactly equal declared addition/removal sets before fill; no implicit expansion.

limitations: This reviews pipeline integration; actual final two-build artifact byte hashes, 206 imports, provider symbols, and source drift will be measured when run2 completes.
Successful Mac packaging does not prove console execution, menu, or spawn; unresolved required layout facts still refuse.
